central_question: Can a reduced vertical hydraulic state reproduce the hydrologically relevant feedback between soil-water redistribution and drought-limited root uptake, despite the fine-scale Feddes functional not being uniquely determined by layer storage alone?
authority_chain: LARE_BC2_C6P_CLOSEOUT.json: retained storage and storage plus geometric first moment are not exactly sufficient for general Feddes feedback.
ROM_ROOT_S2R_CLOSEOUT.json: prescribed-sink reduced harness equivalence qualified.
ROM_ROOT_S3_CLOSEOUT.json: minimal layer-mean-head dynamic feedback falsified in U4, U8, R8 and R16.
ROM_ROOT_S3D1_CLOSEOUT.json: same-state missing-information classes A and B independently confirmed.

minimal_feedback.candidate: theta_bar_i -> h(theta_bar_i) -> alpha(h_bar_i) with exact retained root fraction

arbitrary_demand_dependent_h3.exact_non_tautological_object: root-weighted within-layer pressure-head measure or equivalent threshold-queryable cumulative distribution information

bounded_scientific_conclusion: On the tested mechanistic drought-only Feddes domain, the existing Layer-ROM hydraulic state does not preserve enough within-layer root-weighted pressure-head information for exact dynamic drought-stress feedback. The minimal mean-head approximation is falsified even at R16. Exact same-state uptake at a fixed current stress threshold can be compressed to threshold-aware U/J information, but that compression moves with the demand-dependent h3 threshold and therefore is not a forcing-independent state. Exact arbitrary-h3 feedback returns to distributional within-layer information. The workstream therefore does not justify a new low-dimensional propagated root state.

handoff.next_if_application_tolerance_available: Preregister a forcing-portable approximate root-information family and assess it componentwise against the qualified Reference under an independently frozen purpose-dependent error budget.
handoff.next_if_no_application_tolerance: At most characterize candidate-independent approximation error frontiers. Do not select a state dimension, descriptor count or operationally sufficient representation from observed errors.
